d: Microdramas are turning short-form entertainment into a multi-billion-dollar global business. These bite-sized, vertical television dramas deliver episodes lasting barely a minute or two, with dramatic twists and cliffhangers designed to keep viewers hooked, and often paying to unlock the next instalment. What began in China is now spreading rapidly, with India emerging as Asia’s largest microdrama market outside China. In this video, Firstpost examines the platforms and production houses entering the race, from Kuku TV and JioStar to major Bollywood studios and Hollywood players. We also…
